question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Empathetic
solution:
The correct answer is: **Merciless**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"empathetic"** means showing an ability to understand and share the feelings of another. (सहानुभूति रखने वाला)

 
 
• **Example: **She was very empathetic towards her friend who was going through a tough time.
 
 
 
• **"Merciless"** refers to showing no mercy or pity; being cruel and unfeeling. (निर्दयी)
 
 
• **Example: **The merciless dictator showed no compassion for his people.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'empathetic'** is **'merciless'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Merciless**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Lonely** (अकेला): Sad because one has no friends or company.

 
 
• **Example:** He felt very lonely after moving to a new city.
 
 
 
• **Charismatic** (आकर्षक): Exercising a compelling charm that inspires devotion in others.
 
 
• **Example: **The charismatic leader easily won the support of the crowd.
 
 
 
• **Frustrated** (हताश): Feeling or expressing distress and annoyance resulting from an inability to change or achieve something.
 
 
• **Example:** She was frustrated with the slow progress of her project.
